title: Term Life Insurance Grace Remittance: Restoring a Policy in Its Grace Period
content:
**Policyholder Service Center — Term Life Insurance.**

A Term Life Insurance policy in its grace period is restored to in force by the owner's grace remittance. The policy returns to in force when the grace remittance is received no later than the last day of grace.

The grace remittance is fixed only after the premium mode on record shows quarterly direct billing for a policy whose bank drafts returned in the last 12 months have reached the returned-draft limit.

Before the grace remittance is worked out, the waiver of premium rider on record must already be detached from a policy whose insured's anniversary age has reached the waiver rider expiry age.

| On payment of the grace remittance | Effect on the policy |
|---|---|
| Activity history | one remittance entry against the installment due on the current paid-to date |
| Status | in force again |
| Paid-to date | the date given with the remittance |
| Outstanding premium | zero |

## Invocation: `remit_grace_premium_a5ae3e41`

**Capability.** The owner pays a premium remittance on one Ashgrove term policy that is in its grace period. One remittance of the amount given is entered on the policy's activity history against the installment due on the policy's current paid-to date; the policy is shown in force again, its paid-to date becomes the date given and its outstanding premium becomes zero.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `term_policy_id` | The reference number of the owner's term policy, read from the term policy lookup and given to the owner by the representative | Identifier, as recorded |
| `remittance_amount` | The amount the owner pays | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more are given |
| `payment_method` | How the owner pays | `eft` — a one-time draft from the owner's bank account; `check` — a mailed paper check; `debit_card` — a debit card payment taken over the telephone; `online_bank_payment` — a payment the owner sends from the bank's online bill pay |
| `new_paid_to_date` | The paid-to date the policy carries once the remittance is applied | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** The owner sees a confirmation with `status` ("payment_applied" on success), `payment_id` (the reference number of the new remittance entry), `term_policy_id`, `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `premium_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the installment the remittance was entered against), `paid_to_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the new paid-to date) and `policy_status` (always "in_force").
